Dialogs.Dialog: Hmm... Well, I guess that's fine.
Um... What should I call you...？
▲紹介友達名▲. Nice to meet you.
Did I get it wrong？ ...Okay, let's try again.
▲紹介友達名▲. Yeah, hi. Nice to meet you.
Then just write it down here for me, okay？
▲紹介友達名▲. Okay. Nice to meet you.
Um, is something on the floor？
Hey, what are you doing at a time like this...？
Hm？ Is something on my face？
Hey, don't stare at me like that...
Um... When you stare at me like that...
A-Aren't you a little too close？
Huh？ Was it really that hard...？
Could you be his older brother, maybe？
Could you be his father, by any chance？
Could you be his older sister, by any chance？
Could you be his mother, by any chance？
Huh？ And here I was so sure of it...
Um, how are you two... you know, related？
Um... so how do you two know each other, exactly？
Wait, could you be his dad, then？
Wait, does that make you his little brother, then？
Wait, don't tell me... his mom？
Huh, so does that make you his little sister？
Um, well... I'm dating him. I'm Rinko Kobayakawa. ...Nice to meet you.
You two look alike... So this is how he'll turn out in the future.
Um, well, I know I'm not much, but... it's very nice to meet you.
I see, I see... You two do look alike, huh？ Heh.
Nice to meet you. I've been wanting to meet you at least once. Hehe.
Nice to meet you. I have a little brother too, you know.
Nice to meet you. You look a lot like your dad, huh？
Hey there. Nice to meet you.
I knew it! You two kind of look alike, after all!
Can't beat DNA. I could tell right away.
You really are family, aren't you？ Yeah...
I've been meaning to ask, is your family big on physical affection？
Please continue to be nice to me, okay？
Please take good care of me from now on as well.
Come on, what's wrong with that？ I like it...
There are so many people around. Pretty lively, huh.
Then I'll ask the same thing. How about you？
Has he told you anything about me？
Has he mentioned me to you at all？
I'm getting a little nervous here.
Is this your first time doing something like this？
Is this sort of thing a first for you？
Gotcha. You two are kind of alike, after all.
He always acts so busy, so that's why, huh.
Sorry, this is just what I'm like.
Good thing you got to see him today, then.
Huh？ ...Wonder if he's keeping me a secret.
O-Oh, I see. Sorry to spring this on you out of nowhere.
Oh, okay. Hang in there, Rinko.
O-Oh, really？ I'm a little nervous myself...
Oh, really？ That's a little reassuring.
We haven't been together all that long yet.
It's still pretty recent for us, yes.
Over a year now, I guess. Time sure flies.
It's been over a year now... Yes.
Um, how long has it been... Pretty long now, I think.
We've been together quite a long time now, yes.
Um... Well, he's always with me... That definitely scores a lot of points, yeah.
Um... Well, he's always there for me... And you know how attentive he is.
Hmm... Well, he's warm, or I guess kind, you could say. Hehe.
Um, how should I put it... It's how kind he is.
Well, I mean, he's pretty good-looking, right？ Guess that's about it？ Hehe.
His looks, for one. Not just that, of course, but... you know how handsome he is.
Yeah, well... he's smart, right？ I guess I really like that about him.
Well, um... I'd say it's how smart he is. He's fun to talk to, as well.
Huh？ Come on, you don't need to know that. Pass, pass!
Oh？ Um, let's save that for another time... Yes.
Lately, huh... Oh, getting told my cooking's gotten better. That made me kinda happy. I am a girl, after all.
He complimented my cooking. Lately, that's what made me the happiest.
Lately... I'd have to say getting a present from him. Oh, what it is is a secret. Hehe.
He gave me a present... I think that would be number one, yes.
Something that made me happy... Hmm, getting to spend an important day together, maybe... Huh？ With who？ Um... I'll pass on that.
I'd say getting to spend an important day together... Wait, was I allowed to say that...？
Lately, I guess it'd be having someone special celebrate my birthday. That made me really happy.
He celebrated my birthday for me the other day... That made me really happy.
Something that made me happy lately？ That'd have to be... Never mind, I'll keep it to myself.
What made me happy lately would be... Um, actually, I'll pass. There's a time and a place.
Texts, I guess. He barely sends me any. I know it's a silly thing to fuss over, but... you know.
He doesn't send me very many texts, you see. Please scold him a little for me.
If we're talking complaints, hmm... Not getting enough, maybe. ...You know, physical affection？ Touching and stuff like that？
If I had to name a complaint, it'd be ki... No, never mind... I'll pass.
Our tastes in food don't really match... Stuff like that really starts to wear on you after a while, you know？
Our tastes in food don't quite match, you see. Well, I'm the picky eater between the two of us, though...
He bought a camera, right？ And of course he immediately wants to take pictures of me. From sleazy angles. *Sigh*... Boys, honestly...
He bought a camera recently, and... well, um... Actually, never mind. Please forget I said anything.
I don't know if I'd call it a problem, exactly, but... he's kind of bad at, you know, kissing and stuff？
I don't know if I'd call it a complaint, but... I'd better not say. He'll get mad at me later.
My complaint is... hmm, how he's always touching me... Look, it makes me happy, okay？ It does, but... sometimes I'm just not in the mood, you know？
This is an odd question to ask, but is your family big on physical affection at home？
If we're talking complaints, obviously... Actually, never mind. Pass. That was a close one.
As for complaints, well... I think I'll keep that to myself. Pass.
My hobbies... Reading, I guess. I'm on the library committee just like him. Other than that, music.
My hobby is reading. I'm on the library committee too, just like him. Aside from that, music.
I've been playing in a band lately. Really into that right now. Oh, he's in it too.
Lately, I've been playing in a band together with him.
Hobbies？ I guess I've been really into cooking lately. Pretty girly, huh？ Having someone to cook for makes all the difference. Hehe.
Lately, I've been really into cooking. He eats what I make, so it makes it really rewarding.
Lately, oh, photography and stuff. Though right now I'm strictly the one getting my picture taken. I'm kinda interested in it, though.
Lately, I've been helping him with his photography. Though so far, he's just taking pictures of me.
What I like... Hmm, potato chips and stuff.
Potato ch... Um, potatoes？ Just a little...
Lately, Japanese food, maybe. I've just been eating it a lot.
Lately, he and I eat a lot of Japanese food. It's really grown on me.
Western-style diner food, I guess you'd call it？ Stuff like that. I've been eating it a lot lately.
Western-style diner food, I suppose. I really like this place he and I have been going to lately.
Chinese food. We've just been going a lot lately. I'm a little worried about my cholesterol.
Lately, it's Chinese food. I feel like the two of us go every time we have a date.
Lately I've realized I actually like just about anything. Like it's less about what I'm eating, and more about who I'm with. Hehe.
I actually like just about anything. Everything tastes good when I'm with the person I like, or... Ah, never mind...
First year of high school. I'm 15.
First year of high school. I'm 16.
My hair？ Does it bother you that much？
Um, does my hairstyle really bother you？
Does my hair look weird after all...？
Does my hair really bother you that much？
I just figured something like this would be nice.
My hair is usually more or less like this, though...
Well, you know, he wanted me to wear it like this, so.
Actually, this was by his request...
I talked it over with him and got it cut... Does it look weird？
I talked it over with him and got it cut... Does it look strange？
I asked him first before changing the color, though... Wait, is it weird？
I talked it over with him and dyed my hair... Does it look strange？
W-Well, it's nothing that special, though...
What does it matter？ I'm doing it because I like it.
I wonder about this sometimes, but... do you think he might have bad taste？
Just a quick question, but... does he have bad taste？
I see... I kind of had a sneaking suspicion myself, though...
Right？ Of course he doesn't. Okay, I'll trust him...
Hm？ Does this outfit bother you after all？
Oh？ Does this outfit bother you after all？
Oh, again... Does this outfit bother you that much？
Um... Does this outfit really bother you that much？
My boyfriend asked me to wear it today... Is it weird？
My boyfriend asked me to wear this, actually...
I guess it's his taste... He gave this to me, actually.
My boyfriend gave this to me as a present...
Do you two ever talk about what kind of clothes you like on girls？
Do you and my boyfriend ever talk about what kind of clothes you like on girls？
Guess guys really are into stuff like this, huh...
I see, got it. Well, I guess I'll go along with it.
Oh, really...？ Hmm, guys are complicated...
Do you wear stuff like this？
Do you ever wear stuff like this？
I see. Maybe you and I have pretty similar taste？
Oh, really! Maybe we have pretty similar taste, then？
Do you go for something a little more mature？
Do you usually go for something a little cuter？
I see, I see. Yeah, that makes sense to me.
Hmm？ I wonder what kind, then...
Hey, you're blood type A, right？
You're blood type A, aren't you？
Hey, you're blood type B, right？
You're blood type B, aren't you？
Hey, you're blood type AB, right？
You're blood type AB, aren't you？
Hey, you're blood type O, right？
You're blood type O, aren't you？
I knew it! It's so obvious!
Right？ I was totally sure that was it.
No way! I was so sure I had it right... What's the answer？
Huh？ That's strange... What's the right answer, then？
Oh... That's a little—no, actually pretty surprising...
Really...？ That's a little surprising, actually.
Hey, then I got it right!
I thought so. I'm pretty good at guessing these.
Wait, that means you're the same as him. Did you know？
Oh, the same as my boyfriend. I see, that makes sense.
Okay, my turn. What blood type am I？
All right, my turn now. What blood type do you think I am？
Bingo! A creative, passionate type B, yeah!
Bingo! I knew we clicked! We're the Type B Alliance!
Bzzzt! The answer's type B, same as him. We're a pesky type-B couple. Nice to meet ya.
Too bad, the right answer is type B. Just like my boyfriend. We're a pesky type-B pair.
Hm？ ...Out of curiosity, what makes you say that？
Huh... So that's how I come across. You might not be wrong, though.
What？ Really...？ I don't buy that at all...
Well, I guess you're not totally off the mark, maybe？
By the way, the answer was Type B. I thought it was pretty obvious, though...
So, do you believe in blood type compatibility？
Well then, do you think blood type compatibility is real？
So, what type do you think you get along with best？
Then which blood type are you most compatible with？
You think so？ Most people in India are Type B, you know？
Is it because they're so neat and organized？
Right？ I knew it! Though Type Bs can be a pain...
Oh... Do you have a thing for that two-sided nature？
Is it because they're so easygoing and laid-back？
Then I wonder why. Oh, is someone you like that type？
I wonder why, then... Now I'm curious.
Yeah, I feel like that type might actually suit you.
I feel like I can kind of understand that.
That combination usually gets along pretty well.
That combination is supposed to be a great match, right.
In your case, that might actually work out better.
That might actually be a surprisingly good match.
So going by blood type, you and he are a great match.
Oh, I see. By blood type, you two aren't a great match, though.
What about in real life？ How do you two get along？
I thought so. Yeah, that makes total sense.
Just to check... Do you have any older siblings？
I knew it! You totally seem like a younger sibling. Do you have an older brother？
I knew it! I'm the oldest too, so I can kind of tell. Got a younger brother, then？
Yes! I'm pretty good at guessing this stuff. ♪
An older sister, huh... Now that you mention it, I can definitely see that.
Yes! I got it right again. Pretty impressive, huh？
Too bad. If you had a little brother, we'd be the same.
By the way, I recently got a cute little brother myself.
Since I've got the chance, maybe I'll ask something...
Since I have the chance, may I ask something...？
Has he always been like this？
Has he always been like this, even as a kid？
Huh... I see. That's kind of surprising.
I see... I feel like I can understand that.
Is he always running around making a fuss at home, too？
Is he a bit of a rascal at home, too？
Does he always space out at home, too？
Is he a little spacey at home, too？
So he's the exact same... I figured as much.
I knew it... So he's just being himself, then？
Really！？ Then when he's around me, could he be...？
Oh, really！ That's kind of hard for me to picture.
Around me, I guess he's more on the spacey side？
Around me, I guess he's more on the rowdy side？
Still, when it comes down to it, he's really sweet.
Though he can be a little mean sometimes.
That's what I like about him... Hehe.
That's the part of him I really... like.
He told me you were a really sweet person, but...
He told me you were the cool type, but...
He told me you were on the quiet side, but...
He told me you were really lively, but...
He told me you were pretty serious, but...
He told me you were really funny, but...
When we actually met, you weren't like that at all...
You're just like he said you were.
You're actually really sweet, aren't you？
You're actually really kind, aren't you.
You're actually pretty cool, aren't you？
You're quite the cool type, aren't you？
You're pretty loud, huh？ Oh, in a good way.
You're actually a really funny person, aren't you.
I'm glad I got to meet you today.
I'm really happy I got to meet you today.
Wait, are you his little brother or something？
Wait, are you his little sister or something？
Wait, does that make you his older brother？
Wait, does that make you his older sister？
Um, you're making a scary face...
Um, excuse me... Where are you looking？
You seem like the quiet type.
You're kind of... true to your instincts, I guess...
You have a dirty mind. Did you think I wouldn't notice？
How do I put it... You're pretty curious, I guess.
You sure stare a lot. You aren't thinking anything weird, are you？
You really stare right at me. It makes me a little nervous.
Do you just like being touchy-feely or something？
Way too touchy-feely. It's a little inconsiderate.
You really go at your own pace. Like you only talk on your own timing.
You're way too in your own world. Timing matters in a conversation, you know.
Are you the nervous type？ I wanted to talk a little more, though.
So you're the nervous type. We didn't get to talk much.
You're a little bit, um... Never mind.
You seem a little, um, forward... Well, it's fine, though.
You kept looking all over, so... it made me nervous.
You really look all over, don't you？ It made me pretty nervous.
You kept staring right at me, so... it made me nervous.
You like physical contact, don't you？
You're pretty forward with the touching, aren't you？
Don't you think... you're touching me a little too much？
You like to go at your own pace, don't you？ With your timing in conversation and all.
You really do things at your own pace, don't you？ Especially your timing when we talk.
Were you nervous？ I would've liked to talk a little more.
You were nervous, right？ We didn't get to talk much.
Hey, you look a lot like someone.
Um, you look a lot like someone.
That person who's popular with men right now...
That person who's popular with women right now...
That person who's always on TV...
You know, that person from overseas...
That person I saw in town the other day...
That person everyone looks up to...
That person who's kind of a mess...
Seriously, you look just like them.
Yes, you really look just like them.
Come on, you totally look like them!
That's not true. You really do look like them.
Huh... I really think you look like them, though.
Really？ I think you look like them, though...
Hope we get along from now on.
Please take good care of me from now on as well.
